points.description: States that the reservoir area curve is a plot/graph/relationship of water spread area (surface area of the reservoir) against reservoir elevation (water level/depth).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only one of the two quantities (area or elevation) is correct or the relationship is described vaguely, e.g. 'a curve showing the reservoir's area' or 'area versus capacity'.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for saying it is a plot or relationship between water spread/surface area and elevation (or water level/height/depth) of the reservoir, in any wording. Give 1 mark if the answer is on the right track but vague or names only one correct variable, or pairs area with a wrong second variable like capacity. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers.
